dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000sr4k](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000sr4k) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 47.956 depth occurred on Apr 18 2026 36km SW of Pakera Point. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -10.6594 longitude 161.575. It impacted 20729 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
